description: Validates Helm charts for spec completeness, Chart.yaml validity, values.yaml presence, template file existence, no broken Go-template expressions, values coverage, and chart ownership

rules.description: helm-chart-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare chartName, version, and appVersion
Chart.yaml must exist at the chart root and declare name, version, and apiVersion. Missing any of these causes helm lint and helm install to reject the chart before rendering
rules.note: apiVersion should be 'v2' for Helm 3 charts

rules.description: values.yaml must exist and be non-empty. An absent or empty values.yaml means all .Values.* references in templates render as empty strings, producing invalid or silently broken Kubernetes manifests
The templates/ directory must exist and contain at least one .yaml or .tpl file. A chart with no templates deploys no resources, which is almost always a configuration error

Template files must not contain broken Go-template expressions: empty {{ }}, TODO/FIXME/PLACEHOLDER identifiers, or bare ALL-CAPS identifiers that look like unsubstituted env vars. Block comments ({{/* ... */}}) are excluded from scanning
rules.note: Skipped when templates/ directory is absent

rules.description: Every top-level .Values.<key> reference in template files must have a corresponding top-level key in values.yaml. Missing entries cause helm template to silently render empty strings, which produces invalid manifests (empty image names, missing namespace strings)
rules.note: Skipped when values.yaml or templates/ is absent; checks top-level keys only

rules.description: helm-chart-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers
helm-chart-spec.json must declare a non-empty maintainers array (for ownership accountability) and a description (for discoverability in chart repositories)

constraints.maintainers: Must be a non-empty array of { name, email } objects
